_doc: IA-TIGRIS arms for comparing against the curve planner (mtl_curve) and TIGRIS. They start from the stack tuning (stacks/ia_tigris_search/config/ia_tigris_search_planner.yaml: matched reward, tree recycling, the tigris_search lengths 750/251/750 m and 50 m grid; the released IA-TIGRIS fixed-wing values are 1500/1500/400 m and 30 m, see the _released arm) and use the same detection-matched 60 deg/s sweep as tigris_det_60dps. Each solve is WALL-TIME bounded as flown (5 s, commit margin 3 s): IA-TIGRIS carries its tree across solves and recycling is charged to the solve, so a per-solve iteration cap is not the same compute as TIGRIS's. Give every worker a whole core (--workers <= cores). The _it150 arm is iteration-bounded (150 new samples per solve, deterministic) for a like-for-like check against tigris_det_60dps.
